topics.label: Saskatchewan PNP (SINP)
topics.metaDescription: Saskatchewan Provincial Nominee Program streams for 2026: eligibility focus, Express Entry alignment, and what makes this province's PNP distinct.
topics.lead: Saskatchewan's nominee program focuses on Occupation In-Demand and Express Entry sub-category. A nomination under this program can add 600 CRS points to an Express Entry profile where the stream is aligned, or lead to permanent residence through the province's own separate process where it isn't.
